name: Draft a corporate document
description: Drafts a corporate document from one of Fyniq's templates, filled from the company's records on the day it is drafted: a directors' resolution approving the financial statements, allotting shares, appointing an officer, ending the secretary's or CEO's appointment or changing the registered office; a members' written resolution; the AGM's notice or its minutes; or the notice that the statements were sent without an AGM. It is a draft for the directors and the company secretary to review and have signed: it changes no record, and nothing is signed, lodged or entered in the minute book. Give only the fields its kind asks for, from records you read.

kind.description: The kind of document, as Fyniq's templates name them.

fields.description: The fields its kind asks for, and no other; dates as 2026-12-31, amounts and counts as plain decimals.

fy_end.description: The financial year's last day: approving its statements, the AGM's notice and minutes, the notice that they were sent.

members_approved_on.description: An allotment: the day the members approved the issue (s161).

allottee.description: An allotment: whom the shares are allotted to.

shares.description: An allotment: how many shares, a whole number with no commas.

price.description: An allotment: the price of each share in the base currency, a decimal string.

role.description: An appointment: the office, director, secretary, ceo or auditor.

from.description: An appointment or a change of office: the day it takes effect.

officer_id.description: A cessation: the secretary or CEO in office, by their first version's ID.

on.description: A cessation: the day the appointment ends.

address.description: A change of office: the new registered office.

resolution_kind.description: A members' written resolution: ordinary or special.

resolutions.description: A members' written resolution or the AGM's minutes: the resolutions, one a line.

circulated_on.description: A members' written resolution: the day it is sent to the members.

meeting_on.description: The AGM's notice or minutes: the meeting's day.

time.description: The AGM's notice or minutes: its time, 24-hour.

place.description: The AGM's notice or minutes: its place.

notice_on.description: The AGM's notice: the day it is given.

other_business.description: The AGM's notice: other business, one a line.

chair.description: The AGM's minutes: who chaired it.

present.description: The AGM's minutes: who was present, one a line.

sent_on.description: The notice that the statements were sent: the day they were sent to the members (s175A).

note.description: A note for the record, not on the paper.
